config.selector: detached checkpoint candidates scored with DEV motor progress rewards; no hidden motor sign
config.contextTiming: training and adaptation regime boundaries supplied by experimenter; not autonomously detected
config.policyTraining: one shared base and changed-motor checkpoint per seed for all arms
config.evaluation: held-out source/reversed tasks, independent of probe tasks
config.limitations: engineered target delta, two trained contexts, extra probes/restarts, no neuronal memory simulation
